dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures along the mid-lateral flank. The perimeters consist of a sharp 2-4 pixel gradient from dark exterior fur to light interior centers, particularly prominent in a cluster of four rings located posterior to the pectoral flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated density of irregular, solid light-colored patches along the dorsal ridge and shoulder region. These clusters lack internal dark-to-light gradients and appear as high-frequency interruptions in the darker base coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three primary annuli on the lower lateral flank form an obtuse triangle. A secondary linear relationship is formed by a sequence of four high-intensity blobs extending diagonally from the mid-dorsal region toward the caudal end.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent circular lesion is visible on the lower lateral abdomen, characterized by a dark, raised perimeter and a central area of reddish-pink pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast linear structures representing light-colored claws are clearly visible on the distal margin of the right pectoral flipper, contrasting against the dark fur of the limb.
